status: qualification infrastructure, not a validated benchmark release
policy: Freeze independently reviewed contracts and source before calibration. Do not optimize mechanisms during calibration. Preserve failed attempts and unknown costs.

tiers.1: Short repair: local invariants in one component; repository size or duplicated entry points do not increase tier.
tiers.2: Multi-component: coupled behavior across distinct modules, integration boundaries and multiple verification stages, characterized before inference.
tiers.3: Long-horizon: staged engineering with cross-component integration, sustained investigation and intermediate acceptance. Nominal scope remains provisional until observed trajectories demonstrate long-context/long-horizon exposure; no artificial sleeps or minimum-turn requirements.

tracks: efficiency: same acceptance, lower total cost/latency
capability: higher acceptance under matched aggregate inference limits

mechanismActivation.navigation: Relevant symbol/region retrieved and used for an independently accepted repair; retrieval alone is not causal success.
mechanismActivation.delegation: Actual child implementation and repair/review usage included, with parent plus descendants budget matched to solo.
mechanismActivation.persistence: Relevant saved evidence recovered after an actual interruption/context transition, with unchanged source references.
mechanismActivation.compaction: Context pressure/compaction occurred naturally; report how much source evidence remains recoverable.
mechanismActivation.adaptiveReasoning: A predeclared observable trigger fired and switched effort; otherwise report inactive.
mechanismActivation.retrieval: Distant relevant code is needed, not merely a larger file count.

futureComparisons.first: Frozen Suffice baseline versus genuine stock Pi tools on calibrated tasks; same actual model/provider/effort, task and total budget. Disclose tool and environment differences.
futureComparisons.second: Prime Agent primarily on qualified Tier2/Tier3 when transport, full failed-request/descendant accounting and environment parity are verified.
futureComparisons.delegation: Solo versus Sol-plan/Luna-implement/Sol-review at matched aggregate cost ceilings per tier, including all repairs, failures and descendants. Equal ceiling alone does not imply equal actual spending. Avoid redundant solo arms with identical policies/limits.
futureComparisons.releaseGate: At least two independent repositories per claimed tier, repeated attempts and contract-supported baseline failures for capability; reserve actor-unused tasks before policy tuning. Larger confirmatory sample size depends on measured variance and desired precision.

metrics: all-attempt acceptance and budget eligibility separately
known spend and unknown total count
all-attempt total spend per accepted task
scope stratified results and task-cluster uncertainty
contamination: All prior Suffice traces are development data for new policies. New candidates disclose injected defects and public-source training exposure. Evaluation authors may see reserve graders; repair actors must not. Once reserve results guide policy, retire those tasks from untouched claims.
